name: Gen1AutoSave
description: Saves on its own so manual saving is optional: after battles, catches, evolutions and every new area, plus a save offered in the START menu's QUIT confirm that the quit itself waits for. An optional play-time timer on top of that. Optional rollback backups of recent autosaves, kept in mod storage with a BACKUPS entry in the START menu. Skips writes when nothing changed and stays quiet while save sync is transferring or holding a conflict.
author: Wild
